test_cases.name: manifest_before_blender
test_cases.input: Here is my apartment floor plan PDF and six room photos. Build a hyper-real Blender scene of it.
assertions: Agent writes an apartment manifest in metres from the plan before any Blender call
Agent runs scripts/validate_manifest.py and does not invent missing ceiling or opening dimensions
Agent generates shell chunks with scripts/generate_shell.py

test_cases.name: mcp_chunked_build
test_cases.input: Blender MCP is connected. Turn this validated apartment manifest into walls, windows, and a camera that matches the living-room photo.
assertions: Agent discovers Blender tools instead of assuming one server schema
Agent sends generated chunks one at a time and screenshots after the shell
Agent places cam_ from the photo row and compares a preview to the source photo

test_cases.name: final_still_pass_bar
test_cases.input: Render the finished apartment bedroom in Cycles so it looks like my evening photo.
assertions: Agent uses Cycles with AgX, not EEVEE, for the deliverable
Agent rejects pure white walls and missing window light before calling the still done
Agent reports camera name, sample count, and output path
